claims.claim: French inflation stood at 3.4% in September, up from 2.6% in August.
claims.source_title: French Inflation Accelerates to Highest in Two Years
claims.supporting_quote: Inflation in the euro area’s second-biggest economy stood at 3.4% in September, up from 2.6% in August, statistics agency Insee said.

claims.claim: Tullow Oil shares fell by more than a third after losing an arbitration case over taxes on fields in Ghana.
claims.source_title: Tullow Oil Shares Slump After Loss of Crucial Ghana Tax Dispute
claims.supporting_quote: Tullow Oil Plc shares fell by more than a third after the company lost an arbitration case over taxes on fields in Ghana that account for the bulk of its production.
